notes: Vaegor is the family surname (Cadok, Tyroth, Ostern, Kaan, Veya) so ambiguous. Moonbeam and Sire are Kaan/Raeve terms of address (Kaan calls Raeve Moonbeam; Raeve and staff call Kaan Sire); Raeve impersonates a real servant Ayda in one scene, hence Ayda ambiguous. 'the Burn King' is used for Kaan (Ostern is 'King of The Burn' but named as King Ostern).
